limitations: Conformance is scoped to the accepted contract-pack formats, artifacts, fixtures, and validators; it does not prove later production operations or external integration readiness.
findings.rationale: The accepted F0/F1 contract pack is implemented: sixteen product ADRs and charter artifacts; twelve record/package schemas plus the CloudEvents envelope; four lifecycle machines; 33-path OpenAPI; 24-event AsyncAPI; three adapter interfaces; production fixtures, probes, metamorphic tests, and CI-enforced validation. GATE-0002 and GATE-0003 passed through DEC-0006 and DEC-0008.
findings.title: Accepted F0/F1 contract pack implemented and CI-validated

limitations: Compatibility is an alpha-level architecture and behavior assessment, not a production-readiness, legal, security, privacy, accessibility, reliability, or live-integration determination.
Production key custody, TLS/real identity, aggregate spend accounting, real model-assisted evaluation, live Commerce Foundry/channel crossings, and production operations remain deferred or gated.
findings.rationale: The accepted V1 alpha implements the canonical authority boundaries and core behaviors: independent Engine authority, Studio over public contracts, human authorization, immutable/superseding revisions, exact-content approvals, channel-neutral masters, signed portability, and the runtime boundary. DEC-0017/EVD-0018 record the owner walkthrough and acceptance. Production and live external crossings remain later work, so the assessment is compatible rather than a production-level conformance claim.
findings.title: V1 alpha implements the core architecture; production crossings remain gated

review.basis: Reassessed from the accepted decision/evidence chain through DEC-0017/EVD-0018 and direct inspection during TASK-0012; no production-readiness inference.
